site.title: Harbourline Ops | Back-office teams in Ho Chi Minh City
site.description: Harbourline Ops runs order, bookkeeping, support and data desks in Ho Chi Minh City for retailers and freight firms in Australia and the UK.

data.title: Back-office desks in *Ho Chi Minh City*
data.lead: Harbourline Ops staffs the desks behind online retailers and freight companies in Australia and the UK, from order entry to month-end close, with 210 staff in one city office.

photo.alt: Open-plan office floor with rows of desks

data.text: Retailers should spend their evenings on the next season, not on order backlogs. We take over the *repetitive desks* behind a growing store, run them on your tools and your rules, and send you the numbers every morning so nothing is out of sight.
data.attribution: Linh Tran, founder and managing director

head.title: Five desks we run for you
head.lead: Each desk is a dedicated team with a lead, working in your own systems during your business hours.

cards.title: Order entry and fulfilment support
cards.text: Orders from your store, marketplaces and email are keyed, checked and released to the warehouse the same shift.

photo.alt: Packed parcels waiting on a dispatch table

cards.title: Bookkeeping and month-end close
cards.text: Accountants reconcile bank feeds, post supplier bills and close the month in Xero with a second-person review.

photo.alt: Invoices and a calculator on an accountant's desk

cards.title: Customer support by email and chat
cards.text: Agents answer order and delivery questions in your help desk, with replies checked against your tone guide.

photo.alt: Support desk with a phone and two monitors

cards.title: Freight documents and tracking
cards.text: Coordinators prepare shipping documents, chase carriers and update every consignment in your tracking sheet.

photo.alt: Stacked shipping containers at a port

cards.title: Catalogue and data upkeep
cards.text: Operators load new products, fix listings and clean customer records, with daily counts in a shared report.

photo.alt: Warehouse racks filled with labelled boxes

head.title: From first call to a running desk
head.lead: Most desks go live within five weeks. You approve every step before the next one starts.

steps.label: Week 1
steps.title: Scope call and process walk-through
steps.text: We sit with the person who does the work today, record each step and agree what the desk will and will not handle.

steps.label: Week 2
steps.title: Hire and assign the team
steps.text: We shortlist people with the right tools experience, you interview the lead, and the team signs your confidentiality terms.

steps.label: Week 3
steps.title: Train on your tools and rules
steps.text: The team works through recorded examples in a test copy of your systems until error rates meet the agreed target.

steps.label: Week 4
steps.title: Shadow run beside your staff
steps.text: Your people and ours work the same queue for a week; every difference is logged and fixed in the process notes.

steps.label: Week 5
steps.title: Go live with daily reporting
steps.text: The desk takes over the queue and you receive output, turnaround and error counts every morning in a shared sheet.

data.title: Tell us which desk to *take off your hands*
data.text: Send a short note about the work and a team lead replies with a staffing plan and a monthly price range.

data.blurb: Order, finance, support, logistics and data desks in Ho Chi Minh City for retailers and freight firms in Australia and the UK.
